ai.seo_question: What does 'al-rujz' mean in Surah Al-Muddaththir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-rujz' is often interpreted broadly to encompass not only physical idols but also the spiritual corruption and fear (tadarrus) induced by polytheistic practices, reflecting the Prophet's purification from shirk. This command underscores the foundational principle of *Tawhid* by requiring a complete detachment from all forms of divine association, a theme central to the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings on spiritual clarity.
